node.statement: Fixed-map assembly. With pi_j=I_n tensor Pi_j, exact source relations pi_j pi_k=delta_jk pi_j and pi_1+pi_2=I give X=sum_jk pi_j X pi_k. Since gamma_jk,n=I_n tensor gamma_jk are the amplifications of the same four level-one maps, summing their values on these blocks gives gamma_n=I_n tensor gamma_1, where gamma_1(X)=sum_jk gamma_jk(Pi_j X Pi_k). Thus there is one linear level-one map, not a separately chosen family.
